plan.title: Psoriasis lesional vs control skin DE from TPM
plan.analytical_narrative: The input is a gene-level TPM table from Salmon (12000 genes x 12 samples: 6 lesional, 6 control skin), with no raw counts or quantification directories delivered. Per the grounded procedure for TPM/FPKM input, count-based models (DESeq2/edgeR/voom) are inapplicable because they assume raw integer counts with negative-binomial variance; limma on log2-transformed TPM with eBayes trend=TRUE is the correct route. The plan: (1) QC sample structure on log2(TPM+1) to confirm the two conditions separate and to catch outliers/batch structure in this single-batch unpaired design; (2) filter low-abundance genes (>=1 TPM in at least 6 samples, the smaller group size) and fit a limma linear model (~condition, control as reference) with robust eBayes, extracting the lesional-vs-control contrast with BH-adjusted p-values; (3) run fgsea preranked GSEA on the moderated t-statistic against MSigDB Hallmark (primary) and Reactome (secondary) human gene sets, both staged locally; (4) compile a reproducibility-complete report with thresholds, gene counts, leading-edge genes, and explicit caveats about the TPM-only input and enrichment method-dependence.
